To say that one statement covers the whole person, or that one instance covers their entire era, is incorrect. Feng Houzhai <note>Feng Yi, a Southern Song dynasty scholar</note> said: If we judge him from the time he assisted the ruler and cast the penal statutes, what he lacked was indeed significant. However, judging from the records of the *Spring and Autumn Annals*, we know that the "Way of the Gentleman" was truly scarce in those times. The words of the Sage <note>Confucius</note> neither overflow with excessive praise nor descend into excessive malice. In the *Collected Commentaries* <note>the Jizhu</note>, regarding the righteousness of how he employed the people, the text simply tracks the reality of his actions and cannot be obscured.

Hu Shi <note>Hu Anguo, a Song dynasty scholar</note> said: The three-year period of mourning was the "legacy of love" taught by the disciples of Confucius. The production and planting of the fields and lands up until his death was the "legacy of love" taught to my younger generations. The spirit of Zichan <note>a statesman of the State of Zheng</note> resided entirely within the word "righteousness." When the common people spoke of his kindness <note>term: hui</note> without understanding his governance, they were merely referring to a single instance of him helping others.

The Master said: "Yan Pingzhong was excellent at befriending people; even after a long time, he remained respectful toward them."

Yan Pingzhong was a Great Officer of the State of Qi named Ying. Master Cheng <note>Cheng Yi, a Neo-Confucian philosopher</note> said: Usually, when people have been friends for a long time, their respect for each other fades. To be able to maintain respect after a long time...

<summary>This page discusses the legacy and character of the statesman Zichan, emphasizing that his reputation for kindness was rooted in righteousness, and begins a new section on Yan Pingzhong's excellence in maintaining lifelong respect in friendships.</summary>
<keywords>Zichan, Confucius, Yan Pingzhong, friendship, respect, righteousness, State of Qi, State of Zheng, Song dynasty commentators</keywords>
